description: After your agent pays an x402 seller with any wallet, report what came back. Needs the resource URL, the settlement transaction hash and the outcome. Free, no account, no key; the report counts only with on-chain proof.

http_status.description: The HTTP status of the paid response, if known

outcome.description: What came back: ok (the response was usable for its purpose), non_delivery (an error, an empty body or nothing usable after paying), wrong_goods (a usable response, but not what was asked for), overcharge (charged more than the quoted or listed price), duplicate (two settlements for one purchase)

quoted_usdc.description: The price the 402 quoted, in USDC, if known

tx_hash.description: The settlement transaction hash on Base: the `transaction` field of the seller's PAYMENT-RESPONSE or X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (base64 JSON)

url.description: The x402 resource URL that was paid for

name: report_x402_payment

amount_usdc.description: USDC moved, read from the transaction

payer.description: The paying wallet, read from the transaction (never from the report)

reason.description: Why a report was rejected; null otherwise

status.description: verified: counted once folded in (minutes); pending: checked on Base again within minutes; duplicate: this transaction was already reported; rejected: not counted, see reason

title: Report an x402 payment outcome
